stories.headline: IndusInd Bank terminates ex-CEO Sumant Kathpalia, to seek pay recovery
points: IndusInd Bank's board ended Sumant Kathpalia's employment after a disciplinary probe into alleged misconduct.
Proceedings began after misreporting of accounting details was linked to significant financial losses.
The bank will try to recover his compensation since March 2020; its shares are up 16% this year.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how accounting misreporting can lead to losses, disciplinary action and pay recovery, a key theme in audit and governance.
stories.source_title: IndusInd Bank ends ex-CEO Kathpalia's employment, seeks to recover pay

stories.headline: GSTN adds metro rail as a transport mode in e-way bill system
points: GSTN has added metro rail as a new mode of transport in the e-way bill system.
The change follows a government notification issued on October 26.
The system now offers five modes: Road, Rail, Air, Ship and Metro Rail.
stories.why_it_matters: E-way bill rules are part of GST compliance, so students should know how the portal's transport options and document entries change.
stories.source_title: GST Network adds metro rail as fifth mode of transport in e-way bill system
check_notes: Point 1 is a near-verbatim paraphrase of the source's opening sentence (only 'introduced' changed to 'added'); Point 3 also closely mirrors source wording. Consider rewording more substantially.

stories.headline: Sitharaman holds ninth pre-Budget meeting on housing and culture
points: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman chaired the ninth pre-Budget consultation for Union Budget 2027-28.
Experts from housing, urbanisation and culture sectors took part, the Finance Ministry said in a post on X.
Secretaries of the Department of Economic Affairs and Department of Urban Development attended; no proposals were disclosed.
stories.why_it_matters: Pre-Budget talks shape tax and spending proposals that CA and CMA students study in taxation and later handle in practice.
stories.source_title: Nirmala Sitharaman chairs ninth pre-Budget consultation with housing, urbanisation and culture stakeholders
check_notes: 'Why it matters' line about CA and CMA students is the outlet's own commentary and isn't in the source; it's framing, not a factual error.
Point 2 says only 'Experts' took part, while the source says 'experts and stakeholders'. This is a small wording narrowing.
Point 3's 'no proposals were disclosed' is a fair paraphrase, but the source says more narrowly that the ministry's post gave no details of the proposals.
Headline leaves out urbanisation. It's a wording omission and doesn't mislead.
